args: D3 ruling rules, written before any line is ruled (they hold for every element group; SCHEMA sections 2, 4 and 6; stage D3 sections 1 and 2; J 12:59 on absent lines). G1 instantiate: accept (specification) when the source theme and the cited concepts show the element as stated, inside its range; the element is the shared construct, so no pair is needed. Modify when the how claims more than the concepts show, with a revised sentence inside the evidence. Reject when the concepts show something else, named in the reason. G2 absent marking an evidence limit (unobserved, not-testable): accept with kind evidence-limit, counted apart and never as specification or correction, when the line gives a reason the record cannot show the element; where the room's placements carry the element, I read the cited concepts first and reject the line if they show the element. G3 absent evidenced (observed-absent, not-needed): accept as specification when the cited concepts show the absence or the lack of need; otherwise accept with kind evidence-limit (a reclassification). G4 elaborations (add-condition, add-step, link) and G5 corrections (restrict, contradict): accept with pair when a second room's supported line meets the same target at the same lifted third- or fourth-order node; otherwise particular when the evidence suffices, pending when it does not. Two accepted corrections meeting so trigger the element's re-examination in the same leg, with a written warrant; the count never chooses the revision. G6 a line naming the room itself in its condition or failing portability is a particular (SCHEMA section 4, rule 5); a room named in relation is not. G7 where REPAIRS.tsv bears on a pattern of rulings, repaired and unrepaired rooms are compared. G8 every reason names its evidence: the concepts or the source theme.
